captions.detailed: An upright arcade cabinet rendered in a matte dark grey or black finish. It features a slanted upper monitor bay, a prominent control deck that projects outward from the front face, and a lower service door. A small, functional payout tray flap is positioned near the bottom front. The service door is designed to swing open on a vertical side hinge, while the payout tray flap rotates downward on a horizontal lower hinge.
captions.instruction: Generate a dark grey upright arcade cabinet with a protruding control deck, a slanted screen bay, a vertically hinged lower service door, and a horizontally hinged payout tray flap near the bottom.
captions.factory: Construct the main cabinet body using a lofted or extruded profile to capture the slanted monitor bay and protruding control deck. Create the service door as a separate box-based part attached via a revolute joint on a vertical axis. Create the payout tray flap as another separate box-based part attached via a revolute joint on a horizontal axis near the lower front face.
